The [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] known as the '''bronzewood tree''' was very difficult to cut.<ref name="Streets" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="CNDates">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=07440#17398526|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-14|time=11:47 AM}} &mdash; ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' is set in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> this characteristic led to the analogy that attempting a futile task was like trying to cut one of the non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] trees.<ref name="Streets" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Michael Reaves]] created the bronzewood tree for [[2008]]'s ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' novel series.<ref name="Streets" />
